## Checks

- [ ] I signed off every commit with `git commit -s` for Developer Certificate of Origin (DCO) certification.
- [ ] I ran relevant tests or explained why they were not run.
- [ ] I kept the change provider-neutral and local-first.
- [ ] I avoided adding roadmap, support, response-time, paid feature, or non-threadpoint product promises.
- [ ] I did not add private credentials, private provider output, personal data, or non-redistributable fixtures.
- [ ] I used only synthetic, public, or clearly redistributable fixtures.
- [ ] I checked that new dependencies, fixtures, and copied material are Apache-2.0-compatible.
- [ ] I did not include vulnerability details, secrets, private memory, local paths, backup payloads, or sensitive diffs in public PR text.
- [ ] I updated docs for CLI behavior, output contracts, provider support, or shared layout changes.
